cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(fengshen_whisper_stream LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Verified whisper.cpp 4979e04 source directory")
set(JSON_HEADER "" CACHE FILEPATH "Verified nlohmann json.hpp 55f93686 header")
if(NOT EXISTS "${WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR}/include/whisper.h" OR NOT EXISTS "${JSON_HEADER}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Offline pinned WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR and JSON_HEADER required; no FetchContent/download")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${JSON_HEADER}" JSON_SHA)
if(NOT JSON_SHA STREQUAL "aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "json.hpp hash mismatch")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR}/include/whisper.h" WHISPER_HEADER_SHA)
# Full source archive verification is performed by build_whisper_stream.ps1.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_SERVER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_CUDA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
option(WHISPER_STREAM_VULKAN "Enable Vulkan GPU backend (requires VULKAN_SDK)" OFF)
if(WHISPER_STREAM_VULKAN)
  set(GGML_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
else()
  set(GGML_VULKAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endif()
set(GGML_OPENMP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_CCACHE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
add_subdirectory("${WHISPER_SOURCE_DIR}" whisper-build EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
get_filename_component(JSON_DIR "${JSON_HEADER}" DIRECTORY)
add_executable(whisper-stream main.cpp)
if(WHISPER_STREAM_VULKAN)
  target_compile_definitions(whisper-stream PRIVATE WHISPER_STREAM_VULKAN=1)
endif()
target_include_directories(whisper-stream PRIVATE "${JSON_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(whisper-stream PRIVATE whisper)
enable_testing()
foreach(test IN ITEMS vad utf8)
  add_executable(whisper-stream-${test}-test ${test}_test.cpp)
  target_include_directories(whisper-stream-${test}-test PRIVATE "${JSON_DIR}")
  target_link_libraries(whisper-stream-${test}-test PRIVATE whisper)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(whisper-stream-${test}-test PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4 /EHsc /UNDEBUG)
  else()
    target_compile_options(whisper-stream-${test}-test PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME whisper-stream-${test} COMMAND whisper-stream-${test}-test)
endforeach()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(whisper-stream PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4 /EHsc)
endif()
